C-BROWSER-M1-1-AUDIT-REMEDIATION-2026083.IntentSummary: Remediate the three confirmed M1.1 audit findings without changing the logical browser contract: isolate real Chromium behind an explicit required gate, harden startup readiness, pass all action values through CDP by-value arguments, and rebuild the real Blink AX tree with backend DOM resolution for exact ElementRef actions.

T-001.Title: Add safe CDP Runtime.callFunctionOn and DOM.resolveNode primitives

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: CdpSession can resolve a backend DOM node and invoke a static function with JSON by-value arguments, returning the by-value result and releasing the temporary remote object.
The new CDP path does not interpolate caller-controlled strings into function, expression, selector, or protocol source.

T-002.Title: Restore Blink AX tree and exact AX-to-DOM ElementRef mapping

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: query_document calls Accessibility.getFullAXTree and preserves Blink role, name, value, description, and parent-child relationships while applying QueryBounds.
AX nodes with backendDOMNodeId receive an opaque backend-node ElementRef key; non-DOM accessibility nodes do not receive a fabricated actionable DOM reference.
Input, click, submit, and focus resolve the ElementRef backend node through DOM.resolveNode and execute against that exact remote element.

T-003.Title: Harden Chromium startup readiness and failed-spawn cleanup

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: spawn uses a 30-second overall readiness deadline, detects early child exit, and probes a bounded complete /json/version response instead of relying on one 256-byte read.
Failed startup kills and reaps the child and removes its temporary user-data directory before returning an error.

T-004.Title: Feature-gate real Chromium acceptance and add hostile-input coverage

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: real_chromium_acceptance is enabled only by the real-chromium feature, so cargo test --workspace and the ordinary Correctness suite do not execute it.
The real-engine test verifies backend-node ElementRefs, targeted input/click, stale and nonexistent references, renderer crash containment, and a quote/JavaScript payload that remains literal data.

T-005.Title: Create the dedicated required RealChromium CI gate and document the contract

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Invoke-WorldlineCi exposes RealChromium, excludes the real test from Correctness, and includes the dedicated gate once in All.
PR and master workflows run one named Real-Chromium job on a Windows hosted runner through the repository-owned RealChromium suite.
CI/CD and ADR documentation describe the separate gate, 30-second readiness, safe by-value action dispatch, and Blink AX-to-DOM resolution.

T-006.Title: Run target evidence and reconcile browser verification projection

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Fresh leaf evidence passes for the contract, deterministic spike, dedicated real-engine test, architecture/security checks, Correctness, ProvingSlice, and All suites where the environment supports the gate.
After evidence passes, V-M-BROWSER-CONTRACT-ENGINE-SPIKE records the explicit feature-gated real-engine command and RealChromium repository gate without changing unrelated verification entries.
